en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing four men in early 20th‑century clothing standing on a narrow balcony or walkway with a simple metal railing inside a deep rocky gorge or artificial cascade structure. The scene is dark and dramatic, emphasizing the height and depth of the stone walls around them. Printed caption text appears at the bottom within the white border.
